column3: A fix of an open sharpit bug (#66, the identity held the line of the except header), not a port: BootUI 2.4.0 has no counterpart to settle it, its caught-exception site key keeps the line (CaughtOutcomes.java:746-748, siteKey). The identity follows the principle of AdvisorFindingIdentity.java (structure-derived, never from the order of observation) in sharpit's own plain form <path>:<scope qualified name>:<Type>#<key>, at most 512 characters, with no v1: version prefix and no percent-encoding, because the dismissedFindings store of 0.4.0 to 0.6.0 already holds plain identities. The key is a hash of the clause's try body and handler without positions, so a swap or a log moved between clauses cannot hand a dismissal over; the line-keyed form no longer dismisses and only produces a warning.
